title: Facile preparation of a 3D rGO/g-C3N4 nanocomposite loaded with Ag NPs for photocatalytic degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17089-17101
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02399H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kesheng Cao, Xueyu Ge, Shuang Li, Zhengshan Tian, Suya Cui, Guijin Guo, Liuqing Yang, Xingwu Li, Yabo Wang, Suzhen Bai, Qian Wei, Wei Li
A 3D rGO/g-C3N4 nanocomposite loaded with Ag NPs was fabricated and this obtained nanocomposite with excellent performance was used as an adsorbent and catalyst to efficiently remove MB under visible light irradiation.
